messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up.

output.original_text: Went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up.
output.joy: I happily went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up!
output.sadness: I regretfully went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up.
output.fear: I nervously went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up, hoping it wasn't serious.
output.anger: I went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up, and I can't believe this happened!
output.surprise: I unexpectedly went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up—it caught me off guard!
output.disgust: I reluctantly went to the doctor on Sunday to get my knee all bandaged up; it was just so gross.
